$comment: Shared VfAlert cases. Plain data only. The vocabulary is the historical Vue contract at fd793696f50d3be0fcd3788f0f8f751c63869963. This catalog is not derived from contracts/badge/cases.json or contracts/tag/cases.json and must never be replaced by cases that are: the three components share eight tone names and nothing else. An alert's tone selects a modifier (suppressed at primary, not at neutral - the opposite of the two spans) and a fallback glyph, and changes nothing about the role. There is no dismissible case here because the reference has no dismiss control: no prop, no button, no event. Every case therefore declares zero component-owned controls, and the static snapshot is asserted against the number of controls the *consumer* put in a slot (consumerInteractive), so a dismiss button the component grew fails even when every target grows it identically.

propVocabulary.tone: One of neutral | primary | success | info | warn | help | danger | contrast, default primary. Selects the root modifier (none at primary) and the fallback glyph (four tones share info-circle). Never changes the role.
propVocabulary.title: string, default undefined. Opens the title paragraph and fills it. Tested for truthiness, so an empty string opens nothing on its own.
propVocabulary.icon: Registry glyph name, default undefined. Replaces the tone glyph. Tested with ??, so an empty string is a name.
propVocabulary.hideIcon: boolean, default false. Removes the icon container entirely, consumer icon slot included.

slotVocabulary.icon: Replaces the glyph inside the aria-hidden container. An icon slot that renders nothing brings the glyph back.
slotVocabulary.title: Replaces the interpolated title prop inside the paragraph, and opens the paragraph on its own. A title slot that renders nothing brings the prop text back.
slotVocabulary.body: The default slot. Always wrapped in div.vf-alert__body, which renders whether or not anything is in it.
